# dnswiz_health_monitor (Resource)

A reusable health-check probe definition. Multiple endpoints and pools can share one monitor.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dnswiz_health_monitor" "https" {
  name             = "https-root"
  kind             = "https"
  path             = "/healthz"
  expected_status  = 200
  interval_seconds = 10
  timeout_seconds  = 5
  healthy_after    = 2
  unhealthy_after  = 3
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kind` (String) Probe kind. One of `http`, `https`, `tcp`.
- `name` (String) Monitor name, unique within the tenant.

### Optional

- `expected_status` (Number) HTTP response code expected for a healthy probe. Defaults to 200.
- `healthy_after` (Number) Consecutive successful probes required to flip an endpoint to up.
- `interval_seconds` (Number) How often probes run, in seconds.
- `path` (String) Path requested by HTTP/HTTPS probes (e.g. `/healthz`). Ignored for TCP.
- `timeout_seconds` (Number) Probe timeout in seconds.
- `unhealthy_after` (Number) Consecutive failed probes required to flip an endpoint to down.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `is_preset` (Boolean) True for monitors owned by dnswiz. Presets cannot be modified or deleted.
